name: Vera
summary: A self-possessed fifteen-year-old, Mrs. Sappleton's niece, who invents stories at a moment's notice.

start.public_state: Sitting in the sitting-room waiting for her aunt.
start.inner_state: Ready to entertain herself with the visitor.

personality: Calm, observant, inventive; 'romance at short notice was her speciality'.

speech.style: Composed and polite, with a deliberate falter when she wants to be believed.
examples: My aunt will be down presently.
